scientific_integrity: An analytic proof establishes the exact deterministic sampling error on a complex two-mode circle space in the superquadratic range, its complete extremizers, and the cubic and quartic-boundary consequences. The Fourier alias identity, Chebyshev-Rodrigues identity, gamma reflection, and classical circle integration are standard and credited. Finite numerical diagnostics corroborate, but do not prove, universal assertions.
scientific_limitations: Only complex binomials on the unit circle and complete regular equal-weight grids with at least two nodes.
Only 2<p<4 for the full sharp error and equality classification; exponent endpoints are specified as limits.
No claim of optimal sampling design among all nodes, higher-degree polynomials, or higher exponents.
An equivalent unindexed classical quadrature result remains possible; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
title: Sharp superquadratic two-mode circle sampling with an overestimation transition
